scope.action_scope: documented clocks within 00:00–16:00 ET, plus previous-evening TBR other-session formation/action 20:00–23:00; conditional branch windows explicit in coverage manifest
scope.all_year_capability: arbitrary ISO date range emitted as resumable per-date jobs including coverage dispositions; no outcome-dependent job replacement
scope.comparisons: observable operational research variants, explicit assumption IDs; actual author trades/orders/fills remain separate

complementary_measurements.calendar: closed RTH with no market events produces no market-state observation, with explicit closure disposition
complementary_measurements.candle_endpoints: published same-contract OHLCV at interval close, only after native H/L/V and existing endpoint reconciliation
complementary_measurements.local_flow: order-independent timestamp-batch execution VWAP; conservative tick-valid observed entry reference
complementary_measurements.prior_price_ranges: all prior RTH continuous chart bars; covered native execution bars supplement missing published sessions; contract changes explicit and unadjusted; empty post-expiration c.0 mapping windows excluded with expiration and roll-map receipts
complementary_measurements.prior_volume_profiles: native executed-price volume only; the range supplement never fabricates profile, depth or delta

evaluation_exposure.reason: Existing v1 outcomes, source cases and data investigations have been read. Dates/assumptions frozen before new v2 outcomes; this is engineering verification and descriptive research, not an untouched holdout.

scope.integration_scope: input and boundary verification; these dates are not added to the opportunity denominator unless also in evaluation_dates; no claim of full-session measurement beyond acquired endpoints
scope.market: NQ reconstructed strategy observations using owned native events and reconciled published OHLCV; causal QQQ options/spot context; prior NQ chart history
scope.membership: All original 50 branches and 8 supplementary units retained for reconciliation; setup, context/research and personal execution scopes reported separately.
scope.sample_kind: bounded annual engineering/research sample, not full-archive census
scope.selection: first calendar weekday on or after January 2 of each year 2020 through 2026; no coverage substitution
